text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking hours be extended on Fisken Avenue, between St John's Road and a point 45.7 metres south of Dundas Street West, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week. Residents requested the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Fisken Avenue to improve parking flexibility, and to allow the Parking Enforcement Unit and Toronto Police Service to effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on the odd side of Fisken Avenue, between St John's Road and a point 45.7 metres south of Dundas Street West, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week; 2. Authorized the amendment of the one-hour maximum parking limit on the odd side of Fisken Avenue, between St. John's Road and a point 45.7 metres south of Dundas Street West, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., 7 days a week; 3. Authorized a one-hour maximum parking limit on the odd side of Fisken Avenue, between St. John's Road and a point 45.7 metres south of Dundas Street West, from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., 7 days a week.
